item.title: Dog waste issue, 10th September
item.description:
Dear Sir/Madam, I am contacting you on behalf of the City of London Corporation regarding an ongoing issue raised by our residents. We have received several complaints about an individual regularly using the front garden area of our estate as a dog-fouling area. Despite being approached about this behaviour, the issue has continued. I have attached a photograph of the individual concerned. Could you please look into this matter and advise whether any action can be taken? Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards, Hanan Latif
